turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me before Owen's zero.
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead. I'm going to the principal's office after this anyway. And I want it in writing that nobody called me before that zero went in.
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow is Wednesday, November 11th, so you have a day to find something you can show me. Until then, you have a score and a threat. What else?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that nothing be placed on Owen's record, and that you put in writing why no one contacted me before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a trip to the principal, and she agreed to nothing; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because you never showed her a document she could check, so there was nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and then threatened to make it official, which gave her a machine's guess and a threat to push against, and the same threat repeated hit the same wall.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed nothing about his process, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After your first line, own that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated record of Owen's own process in front of her, such as when he worked on the essay, instead of the score.
